oauth.clientIdHint: The Strava Client ID is a number, such as 123456

tools.name: get_athlete
tools.description: Get the connected Strava athlete's profile: name, location, weight, FTP, measurement preference, and their bikes and shoes with the distance on each.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{},"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: get_athlete_stats
tools.description: Get the connected athlete's ride, run, and swim totals for the last 4 weeks, the current year, and all time, plus their longest ride and biggest climb. Strava only counts activities visible to Everyone. Distances and elevations are in meters, durations in seconds, and speeds in meters per second.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{},"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: get_athlete_zones
tools.description: Get the connected athlete's heart rate and power zone boundaries.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{},"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: list_activities
tools.description: List the connected athlete's activities with summary metrics: distance, time, elevation, speed, heart rate, and power. Results are newest first, or oldest first when "after" is set. Call get_activity for the full detail of one activity. Distances and elevations are in meters, durations in seconds, and speeds in meters per second.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"after":{"type":"string","description":"Only activities that started after this ISO 8601 date or datetime, such as 2026-01-31."},"before":{"type":"string","description":"Only activities that started before this ISO 8601 date or datetime."},"page":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"default":1,"description":"Page number, starting at 1."},"per_page":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":30,"description":"Number of items per page."}},"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Get one activity in full: description, calories, device, gear, splits, laps, and best efforts. Distances and elevations are in meters, durations in seconds, and speeds in meters per second.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"activity_id":{"type":"integer","description":"Activity identifier, as returned by list_activities."},"include_segment_efforts":{"type":"boolean","default":false,"description":"Also return every segment effort of the activity. This makes the result much larger."}},"required":["activity_id"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: get_activity_streams
tools.description: Get the time series recorded during an activity, such as heart rate, power, cadence, speed, and altitude. Each stream is reduced to at most max_points evenly spaced samples that share the same positions, so index i of every stream is the same moment. Distances and elevations are in meters, durations in seconds, and speeds in meters per second.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"activity_id":{"type":"integer","description":"Activity identifier, as returned by list_activities."},"keys":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["time","distance","latlng","altitude","velocity_smooth","heartrate","cadence","watts","temp","moving","grade_smooth"]},"default":["time","distance","altitude","velocity_smooth","heartrate","cadence","watts"],"description":"Streams to return. Strava omits streams the activity did not record. \"latlng\" contains GPS coordinates."},"max_points":{"type":"integer","minimum":2,"maximum":1000,"default":200,"description":"Maximum number of samples per stream."}},"required":["activity_id"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: get_activity_zones
tools.description: Get the time spent in each heart rate and power zone during an activity, in seconds. Strava requires a subscription for this data.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"activity_id":{"type":"integer","description":"Activity identifier, as returned by list_activities."}},"required":["activity_id"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: list_activity_comments
tools.description: List the comments on an activity.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"activity_id":{"type":"integer","description":"Activity identifier, as returned by list_activities."},"page":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"default":1,"description":"Page number, starting at 1."},"per_page":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":30,"description":"Number of items per page."}},"required":["activity_id"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: list_activity_kudos
tools.description: List the athletes who gave kudos to an activity.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"activity_id":{"type":"integer","description":"Activity identifier, as returned by list_activities."},"page":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"default":1,"description":"Page number, starting at 1."},"per_page":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":30,"description":"Number of items per page."}},"required":["activity_id"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: list_starred_segments
tools.description: List the segments the connected athlete starred. Distances and elevations are in meters, durations in seconds, and speeds in meters per second.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"page":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"default":1,"description":"Page number, starting at 1."},"per_page":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":30,"description":"Number of items per page."}},"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: get_segment
tools.description: Get a segment: distance, grade, elevation, effort counts, and the connected athlete's personal record and effort count on it. Distances and elevations are in meters, durations in seconds, and speeds in meters per second.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"segment_id":{"type":"integer","description":"Segment identifier."}},"required":["segment_id"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: explore_segments
tools.description: Find up to 10 popular segments inside a latitude/longitude bounding box. Distances and elevations are in meters, durations in seconds, and speeds in meters per second.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"south_west_lat":{"type":"number","minimum":-90,"maximum":90},"south_west_lng":{"type":"number","minimum":-180,"maximum":180},"north_east_lat":{"type":"number","minimum":-90,"maximum":90},"north_east_lng":{"type":"number","minimum":-180,"maximum":180},"activity_type":{"type":"string","enum":["riding","running"],"default":"riding"},"min_climb_category":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":5,"description":"Lowest climb category to include, from 0 (uncategorized) to 5 (hardest)."},"max_climb_category":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":5,"description":"Highest climb category to include, from 0 (uncategorized) to 5 (hardest)."}},"required":["south_west_lat","south_west_lng","north_east_lat","north_east_lng"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: list_segment_efforts
tools.description: List the connected athlete's efforts on one segment, optionally within a date range. Strava requires a subscription for this data. Distances and elevations are in meters, durations in seconds, and speeds in meters per second.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"segment_id":{"type":"integer","description":"Segment identifier."},"start_date":{"type":"string","description":"Only efforts on or after this ISO 8601 date or datetime."},"end_date":{"type":"string","description":"Only efforts on or before this ISO 8601 date or datetime."},"per_page":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":30,"description":"Number of items per page."}},"required":["segment_id"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: List the routes the connected athlete created. Distances and elevations are in meters, durations in seconds, and speeds in meters per second.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"page":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"default":1,"description":"Page number, starting at 1."},"per_page":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":30,"description":"Number of items per page."}},"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: Get a route: distance, elevation gain, estimated moving time, and the segments along it. Distances and elevations are in meters, durations in seconds, and speeds in meters per second.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"route_id":{"type":"string","description":"Route identifier, as returned by list_routes. Pass it as a string."}},"required":["route_id"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: list_clubs
tools.description: List the clubs the connected athlete is a member of.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"page":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"default":1,"description":"Page number, starting at 1."},"per_page":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":30,"description":"Number of items per page."}},"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: get_gear
tools.description: Get a bike or pair of shoes: brand, model, and total distance in meters. Gear identifiers come from get_athlete and from the gear_id of an activity.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"gear_id":{"type":"string","description":"Gear identifier, such as b1234567 or g1234567."}},"required":["gear_id"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: create_activity
tools.description: Create a manual activity on the connected athlete's Strava account, such as a workout recorded without a device. It appears in their feed like any other activity. Strava has no API to delete an activity, so confirm the details with the user first. Distances and elevations are in meters, durations in seconds, and speeds in meters per second.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","maxLength":255,"description":"Activity title."},"sport_type":{"type":"string","description":"Strava sport type in PascalCase, such as Run, TrailRun, Ride, GravelRide, MountainBikeRide, VirtualRide, Swim, Walk, Hike, WeightTraining, Workout, or Yoga."},"start_date_local":{"type":"string","description":"Start in the athlete's local time as an ISO 8601 date and time, such as 2026-01-31T18:00:00."},"elapsed_time":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"description":"Duration in seconds."},"distance":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"description":"Distance in meters."},"description":{"type":"string","maxLength":5000},"trainer":{"type":"boolean","description":"Recorded on an indoor trainer or treadmill."},"commute":{"type":"boolean","description":"Mark the activity as a commute."}},"required":["name","sport_type","start_date_local","elapsed_time"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: update_activity
tools.description: Change an activity of the connected athlete: its title, description, sport type, gear, or its commute, trainer, and muted flags. Only the fields you pass are changed. Strava's API cannot change an activity's visibility, date, distance, or time.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"activity_id":{"type":"integer","description":"Activity identifier, as returned by list_activities."},"name":{"type":"string","maxLength":255,"description":"New title."},"description":{"type":"string","maxLength":5000,"description":"New description. Pass an empty string to clear it."},"sport_type":{"type":"string","description":"Strava sport type in PascalCase, such as Run, TrailRun, Ride, GravelRide, MountainBikeRide, VirtualRide, Swim, Walk, Hike, WeightTraining, Workout, or Yoga."},"gear_id":{"type":"string","description":"Gear identifier from get_athlete, such as b1234567, or \"none\" to remove the gear."},"commute":{"type":"boolean"},"trainer":{"type":"boolean"},"hide_from_home":{"type":"boolean","description":"Mute the activity so it stays out of followers' home feeds."}},"required":["activity_id"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: update_athlete_weight
tools.description: Set the connected athlete's weight on their Strava profile, in kilograms. Strava uses it to estimate power and calories.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"weight":{"type":"number","minimum":20,"maximum":400,"description":"Weight in kilograms."}},"required":["weight"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.name: star_segment
tools.description: Star or unstar a segment for the connected athlete.
tools.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"segment_id":{"type":"integer","description":"Segment identifier."},"starred":{"type":"boolean","default":true,"description":"True to star the segment, false to unstar it."}},"required":["segment_id"],"additionalProperties":false}

outcomes: !after must be an ISO 8601 date or datetime, such as 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T18:00:00Z
!before must be an ISO 8601 date or datetime, such as 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T18:00:00Z
!page must be an integer of at least 1
!per_page must be an integer between 1 and 100
!activity_id must be an integer of at least 1
!max_points must be an integer between 2 and 1000
!keys must be a non-empty array of: time, distance, latlng, altitude, velocity_smooth, heartrate, cadence, watts, temp, moving, grade_smooth
!segment_id must be an integer of at least 1
!south_west_lat must be a number between -90 and 90
!south_west_lng must be a number between -180 and 180
!north_east_lat must be a number between -90 and 90
!north_east_lng must be a number between -180 and 180
!activity_type must be one of: riding, running
!min_climb_category must be an integer between 0 and 5
!max_climb_category must be an integer between 0 and 5
!start_date must be an ISO 8601 date or datetime, such as 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T18:00:00Z
!end_date must be an ISO 8601 date or datetime, such as 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T18:00:00Z
!route_id must be a numeric route identifier
!gear_id must be a gear identifier such as b1234567
!name must be text of at most 255 characters
!sport_type must be a Strava sport type like Run
!start_date_local must be an ISO 8601 local date and time, such as 2026-01-31T18:00:00
!elapsed_time must be an integer between 1 and 2592000
!distance must be a number between 0 and 10000000
!description must be text of at most 5000 characters
!gear_id must be a gear identifier such as b1234567, or "none"
!weight must be a number between 20 and 400
